count_definitions.effective_campaign_turn: checkpoint.progress.turns_total: only campaign advancement, unchanged on locally rejected actions.
count_definitions.recommended_question_gap: Use submitted_action distance cp.turn - last_mention.turn, report effective campaign-turn difference and ancestor-edge distance separately. Last mention must inspect committed narration, dialogue, available options and actual selected player actions; memory summaries/retrieval repetition and current structured state availability need separate channel flags.
count_definitions.submitted_action: Checkpoint top-level turn / state.turn: one persisted generate action including rejected action. Initial checkpoint is 0; application parse retry repeats the same action and does not create a new action index.
count_definitions.timeline_node: checkpoint.head is database story_turns.id. All four captured chains begin at node 1 (initial root); each submitted action adds one descendant node. Node IDs are identifiers, not a general distance measure; use ancestry/depth for distance. In these four linear recordings only, head=turn+1.

limitations: All four games share the same campaign and budget-incomplete / 未竟的追寻 ending at effective turn 50; investigation incomplete, not four distinct endings.
PCB persona extraction fails before API calls with KeyError; no actual PCB API coverage. NSB summaries are independently present.
Each game has two complete HTTP 404 embedding attempts followed by existing hash fallback, so semantic retrieval quality must not be inferred.
Coverage counts are event counts, not unique items/entities or independent game samples.
All formal games have consumed_item_state uncovered; an inventory removal alone is not proof of consumption.
Uncommitted invalid narration / JSON-repair / ending attempts are not canonical story history. Use committed output and authoritative state.
Strict replay success verifies reproducibility of recorded flow, not semantic truth or model memory performance.
strict_replay_scope: Independently inspected and hash-verified existing strict raw-response replay results; did not execute game replay during this audit.
